7 · OPTIONAL — Local LLM with Vault as RAG
Requires capable hardware (Apple Silicon Mac or equivalent). Not part of core workflow.
MLX auto-selected on Apple Silicon; runs existing GGUFs.
RAG node: primary Apple Silicon Mac only
Gemma 4 26B + Vault — daily default · MoE (~16 GB)
Each "+ Vault" pre-attaches the Knowledge collection
Nightly LaunchAgent · pushes to Open WebUI Knowledge
Indexes ~/Obsidian; profile note anchors role context
Open WebUI bound to localhost only
Secondary node: personal models via LM Studio + LM Link (no vault)

Each input lands in its target capture folder under ~/Obsidian (destinations noted inside each input box). Ingest LaunchAgents do mechanical, deterministic cleanup at the edge: voice_cleanup polishes dictations (~1 Claude API call

each); strip_ads removes NYT/WSJ ad blocks (no API); YouTube share-sheet captures route through the Claude summarizer; podcast_watch transcribes drops locally (MLX Whisper → faster-whisper → ONNX, one episode
per 900-sec tick) into Clippings/; com.tag-clippings auto-tags every 30 min. Articles are clipped by hand with the Obsidian Web Clipper in a signed-in browser — no automation, no stored credentials.

iCloud Drive is no longer a dependency anywhere in the workflow. Phone-originated captures (band 5) now reach the Mac by mail: the device signs a plain-text payload with HMAC-SHA256 and emails it to a dedicated intake

mailbox; com.obsidian.source-mail-pull fetches it over IMAP every 300 s and writes it into ~/SourceMedia/{VoiceInput,PodcastInput}/. This separates the drop-folder contract from the transport, so the watchers

were unchanged — and it removes Apple iCloud for Windows from machines that otherwise need nothing from Apple. A mailbox is world-writable, which is why the payload carries its own proof: unguessable address, sender
allowlist, MAC over a length-prefixed canonical string, routing type taken from inside the MAC, a 7-day replay bound, and locally generated filenames. The token itself is never transmitted.

A second class of jobs (band 6) operates ON the vault rather than ingesting: com.morning-dashboard builds a 7 AM weekday HTML surface; meeting-prep grafts attendee follow-ups into today's notes; meeting-prepopulate consumes
an MCP-connector-fed schedule handoff (mcp_meeting_transform.py, no OneDrive/Cowork); group-photo refresh runs nightly.

Every note now carries a policy-aligned `classification` property (public / internal-use-only / confidential / restricted), set at create-time; restricted is excluded from the local RAG sync. All automation scripts are canonically

located at ~/Obsidian/Templates/Scripts. Vault content is replicated cross-device via Obsidian Sync with E2E encryption (key in the local OS keychain only); secrets, code repos and ~/SourceMedia sit outside the sync scope.
